function.name: granch_log_voice_note
function.description: Log one or more cattle, calving, veterinary treatment, sale, chore, or financial events in a single atomic ranch transaction via POST /api/ai/ingest.

transcript.description: Raw natural-language voice note from the rancher (e.g., 'Cow 214 had a bull calf this morning, gave her a shot of penicillin, and spent $320 on hay at the co-op').

actions.description: Optional pre-parsed structured actions if Instinct AI extracts entities directly.

function.name: granch_query_ranch
function.description: Query live herd counts, due dates, animal profiles, active withdrawals, recent logs, or cash-flow totals via POST /api/ai/query.

question.description: Natural-language question about the ranch (e.g., 'How many cows are pregnant and what did I spend on feed this month?').
